sloka: ये तु रामस्य सुहृदः सर्वे ते मूढ चेतसः ।शोक भारेण च आक्रान्ताः शयनम् न जुहुस् तदा ॥२-४१-२०॥
transliteration: ye tu rāmasya suhṛdaḥ sarve te mūḍha cetasaḥ ।śoka bhāreṇa ca ākrāntāḥ śayanam na juhus tadā ॥2-41-20॥

translations.english: All the friends of Rama were stupefied. Afflicted with the burden of sorrow they did not leave their bed.
